description: This file appears to be a shell script with functions related to Git operations, including tagging, committing, and manipulating commit dates. It includes functions for generating unique commits, saving tags, replacing hashes with symbolic names, and managing author and commit dates.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Verifies if a given Git tag exists by its name.

methods.name: unique_commit
methods.description: Creates a unique commit based on provided text and tree, identified by a tag.

methods.name: save_tag
methods.description: Saves the current state of a tag with a substitution script applied, updating the ref.

methods.name: entag
methods.description: Replaces SHA1 hashes in the input with their symbolic tags using sed script.

methods.name: as_author
methods.description: Runs a command with the GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL temporarily set to a specified value.

methods.name: commit_date
methods.description: Extracts the commit date from a given commit hash.

methods.name: assign_fake_date
methods.description: Assigns a fake date string, handling various missing components.

methods.name: on_committer_date
methods.description: Runs a command with the GIT_COMMITTER_DATE temporarily set to a specified date.

methods.name: on_dates
methods.description: Runs a command with GIT_COMMITTER_DATE and GIT_AUTHOR_DATE set to specified values.

methods.name: hide_error
methods.description: Runs a command, suppressing any error output.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs a command and compares its output to an expected result, verifying correctness.

methods.name: name_from_description
methods.description: Converts a description string into a sanitized name suitable for test naming.

methods.name: test_output_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test command expecting success, comparing output to expected.
